name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML, render video. Compositions, GSAP animations, captions, voiceovers, audio-reactive visuals, and website-to-video capture for HyperFrames.
author: HeyGen <hyperframes@heygen.com> (https://hyperframes.heygen.com)

interface.longDescription: Build videos from HTML with HyperFrames. Author compositions with HTML + CSS + GSAP, use the CLI for init/preview/render/transcribe/tts, install reusable registry blocks and components, follow the GSAP animation reference, and turn any website into a video with the 7-step capture-to-video pipeline.
